material.$description: Glass: translucent layered fill, rim highlight, specular sheen and a glacier glow. Components fall back to material.solid when transparency is reduced or backdrop-filter is unsupported.

tint.$description: Glacier tint layered over the fill.

edge.$description: Hairline border of a glass layer.

rim.$description: Specular rim on the top edge.

glow.$description: Glacier glow around focused and pressed controls.

hairline.$description: The only border a borderless surface keeps, where separation needs it.

spin.$description: Machined spin: the default finish of every button, on glass and off it. A conic sweep of machined stops under a fine concentric grain, both centred on the button, so an icon-only circle is a turned knob. Ink is checked against the lightest and darkest stop of each body, ghost text on the faint wash and the disabled ink on matte (tooling/contrast).

stop.$description: The secondary body: seven machined stops round the conic sweep (the sweep closes on stop 1).

2.$description: Lightest stop; also the flat fill under prefers-contrast: more.

ink.$description: Text and icons on the secondary body.

signal-ink.$description: Text and icons on the Glacier body.

grain-dark.$description: Dark ring of the concentric grain (1px of every 2px).

grain-light.$description: Light ring of the grain on the secondary body.

signal-grain-light.$description: Light ring of the grain on the Glacier body.

emboss.$description: The 1px light under the label: the text reads as cut into the metal.

sheen.$description: Peak of the light band that slides across on hover and focus.

shadow.$description: Bevel (light top edge, dark lower edge), outer hairline and a short drop.

shadow-press.$description: Pressed: the bevel flips, so the face reads as pushed in.

ghost.$description: Opacity of the faint metal a ghost button takes on hover, focus and selection.

ghost-edge.$description: Hairline round the ghost wash, so it reads as metal, not a flat fill.

matte.$description: Disabled: a flat matte body, no grain or sheen; color.line.2 keeps its edge.

matte-ink.$description: Disabled label on matte (3:1, it is not actionable).

liquid.$description: Liquid glass layers: glacier tint, specular highlight, rim, inner glow and drop shadow.

texture.$description: Tactile texture of the soft button finish (finish="soft"): fine brushed lines (light and dark, two coprime periods), a soft top highlight and a low inner bevel. signal-* is tuned for the Glacier primary. Text on every textured button body is checked with the lines and highlight composited (tooling/contrast).

top.$description: Peak of the soft top highlight.

bevel-hi.$description: Inner top edge of the bevel.

bevel-lo.$description: Inner lower edge of the bevel.

backdrop.$description: Animated star backdrops (@northstar-js/react/backdrops). Decorative: the stars carry no meaning, but the ground is checked as a ground for text, and ink and signal as marks on it.

signal.$description: The few Glacier stars, links and the north star.

glow.$description: Peak opacities of the soft glows: nebulae, the orrery core and the interference band.
